description: A React component implementing an advanced text editor for posting messages, including features like markdown formatting, file uploads, mentions, and editing capabilities within the Mattermost application.

classes.name: AdvancedTextEditor
classes.description: React component for an advanced message editing interface with markdown, file uploads, mentions, and editing features.

methods.name: emitTypingEvent
methods.description: Emits a typing indicator event to the server.

methods.name: handleDraftChange
methods.description: Updates the draft message and optionally saves it immediately.

methods.name: applyMarkdown
methods.description: Applies markdown formatting to the message draft.

methods.name: toggleAdvanceTextEditor
methods.description: Toggles the advanced text editor's formatting bar visibility.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles message submission, including error handling.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Cancels message editing and clears the draft.

methods.name: handleRemoveAllLabels
methods.description: Removes all priority and burn-on-read labels from the draft.

methods.name: handleSubmitWrapper
methods.description: Wraps handleSubmit to include modal confirmation for empty edits.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events in the textbox.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles change events in the textbox.

methods.name: prefillMessage
methods.description: Prefills the message input with a given message.
